medications.guardrail: This app is a log and a reminder, not a medical device, and it gives no dosing advice. The prescription from your doctor is the source for every dose and interval.
medications.sameIngredient: Contains the same active ingredient as {{names}}: {{substances}}. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before substituting.

early.partGiven: Already given {{when}} at {{time}}. Log another dose anyway?
early.outsideParts: Not one of the prescribed parts of the day ({{parts}}). Log anyway?
early.wait: Too early: next allowed at {{time}}. Log anyway?
early.limit: Daily limit reached: next allowed at {{time}}. Log anyway?
early.ended: This course ended on {{date}}. Log anyway?
early.notStarted: This course starts on {{date}}. Log anyway?

confirm.title: Confirm {{name}}
confirm.noWeight: No weight on record, so there is no suggestion. Enter the dose from your doctor's prescription.
confirm.stale: This weight is from {{date}}, more than 30 days ago. Check the weight before giving this dose.
confirm.youConfirm: This only does the arithmetic on the prescription you entered. Check the amount, then confirm.

catalog.title: From the shared catalog
catalog.notListedOffline: Not listed? Go online to add it
catalog.byIngredientNote: Information only. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before substituting.
catalog.officialAttribution: Source: Anvisa open data (registered medicines and the CMED price list). Not reviewed by a pharmacist; not medical advice.
catalog.curated: Curated list (not reviewed by a pharmacist)
catalog.ingredientNotListed: Ingredient not listed in the official data
catalog.ambiguousName: Different products share this name with different ingredients. Check the box.

newProduct.title: Add to the shared catalog
newProduct.help: Other families on this server will find it by name. Use the name and form printed on the package.
newProduct.name: Name
newProduct.countryHelp: Two letters, like BR or US.
newProduct.nameInvalid: Enter the name (at least 2 letters or digits).
newProduct.existed: {{name}} was already in the catalog, so that one is used.

editor.dayPartsHelp: One dose in each chosen part, at any time inside it: {{windows}}.
editor.partRemindersHelp: Off by default. A reminder is sent only while that part has no dose yet, and only with medicine reminders on in Settings.
editor.summaryEmpty: Fill in the dose and when it is given, and the prescription is read back here.
editor.perKgHelp: The app multiplies the prescribed amount by the latest weight and always asks you to confirm.
editor.noWeight: No weight on record yet. Add one under Growth to get a suggestion.
editor.minIntervalHelp: The shortest wait the prescription allows between doses.
editor.groupHelp: A dose of any medication in the same group restarts the wait for all of them.
editor.groupPlaceholder: Name a new group, like colic

errors.partsRequired: Choose at least one part of the day.
errors.halfCount: Use whole or half suppositories (for example 0.5, 1 or 1.5).
errors.timesDistinct: Each time can be listed once.
errors.endDate: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.perKgCounted: A per-kg dose is only for measured units like drops, ml or mg, not for sprays, puffs, suppositories or applications.
errors.wholeCount: Use a whole number of sprays or puffs.

settings.noPrescriptions: No prescriptions yet. Add what the doctor prescribed to see when the next dose is allowed.

dialog.linkHelp: Linking shows the form and active ingredient and avoids duplicate entries.
dialog.offlineHelp: Offline: only products saved on this device can be found. You can save a plain medication and link it later.
